notes: Account background: Mid-market product analytics SaaS, PLG motion, 350 employees, heavy UI onboarding flows.
Primary ask: In-app onboarding copilot to guide new users through flows, reduce time-to-value. Must be embedded in product with near-real-time responses.
Workload: High concurrency during signup bursts (expected peak 600 concurrent lightweight chats), average session 12 messages, 120 tokens/message.
Latency SLOs: target p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for streaming responses. Want consistent tail latency for tool-calling paths (external API lookups).
Cost sensitivity: strict token budget per user journey. Need per-session token caps + automatic fallback to cached replies when approaching cap.
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family or Red‑verified models; willing to evaluate 4-bit quantized variants for Dedicated. Want dropout fallback to smaller model for overflow.
Routing/fallback: prefer hosted first (fast onboarding), then Dedicated reserved GPUs for steady throughput. Plan: hosted for canary -> dedicated for production for cost predictability.
Streaming & tool calling: must support chunked streaming to UI, resumable streaming on reconnect, and server-side verification of tool call outputs (idempotency).
POC acceptance criteria (draft): 1) sustained p95 under 500ms at 250 concurrent chats; 2) token cost within modelled budget +/-10%; 3) tool calls return verified outputs < 800ms end-to-end.
Security/regulatory: EU customer subset requires data residency; legal flagged 'on-prem option' for top-15 clients. Need audit logs, retention controls, and KMS integration.
Pricing conversation: asked for Hosted-to-Dedicated migration credit, guaranteed committed throughput tiers, and clear overage rules. AE shared pricing deck link.
Quotes: 'Can we cap tokens per journey and never bill beyond that threshold?' - Product PM. Team wants explicit enforcement and alerts.
Integrations: SSO (SAML), Segment event hooks, feature flagging for gradual rollout, Webhook endpoints for tool calls.
Next technical tasks: deliver POC test harness (sample UI + load generator), config for prefix caching and KV cache warmers, model profile recommendations.
Open action items: legal to review Dedicated contract variant for EU residency; SE to provide quantized model perf matrix; pricing to confirm ARR tiers.
